name: Uke Shokushu
source:
Michio was born as a tentacle monster, but he rejected his own identity and decided to live as a human. However, with his childhood friend trying to take full advantage of his lewd beast potential and his mother pressing him to accept his true form, his daily life is anything but boring!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
